comment: Launch checks that apply to every app, regardless of which SDKs were detected. Each is a verifiable claim about the launch that lives outside the stores: Agentship reminds, the agent checks or does the work with its own tools, and the user may dismiss any of them with a reason. Never a gate — Agentship does not verify these and no plan is blocked by them.

checks.claim: The privacy policy is published at a public HTTPS URL that resolves — both stores reject a listing whose privacy policy link is dead.
If the app has terms of service, they are published at a public HTTPS URL that resolves.
The support URL or support email in the store listings is real and monitored — review teams and users will write to it.
Store screenshots and listing texts describe the build being submitted, with no placeholder content left.
